PhD research programmes
The University of Groningen offers a broad research spectrum ranging from the Humanities to Medical Sciences that covers most of the academic disciplines . Within these disciplines the University of Groningen focuses on several specific research themes, like the ones listed below. Please contact the individual Graduate Schools for a current overview.
Arts
Graduate School for the Humanities
Groningen Institute of Archaeology
The Groningen Research Institute for the Study of Culture (ICOG)
Centre for Language and Cognition
Contact this Graduate School via
gsh-groningen rug.nl

Graduate School of Behavioural and Social Sciences
Psychology
Sociology
Pedagogy and Educational Sciences: Nieuwenhuis Institute and GION
Contact this Graduate School via gradschool.bss rug.nl

Graduate School of Economics and Business
Related research institute:
FEBRI Research Institute
Economics, Econometrics & Finance
